FOREWORD

This document presents a review of principles and
practice related to the design of filters for use in drainage
systems for earthworks in Hong Kong. Recommendations are
made for design of filters, and guidance is given about their
construction.

The document was prepared in the Geotechnical
Engineering Office (GEO) under the direction of Messrs J.B.
Massey and Y.C. Chan. It draws on the findings of two
research projects under the GEO Research & Development
Theme on Slope Stability and Drainage Measures. These
projects involved reviews of granular filters and geotextile
filters by Mr L.C. Mak and Dr P.L.R. Pang respectively.
This document was edited initially by Mr S.H. Tse and
Dr T.S.K. Lam and later by Mr S.H. Mak and Mr K.K.S. Ho,
and it was reviewed by Dr P.L.R. Pang and Mr K.S. Yuen.
In the course of preparing this publication, many individuals in
the GEO have also provided input, and their contributions are
gratefully acknowledged.

Practitioners are encouraged to provide any comments
they may have on the contents of this publication to the
Geotechnical Engineering Office.

A.W. Malone
Principal Government Geotechnical Engineer
December 1993
